title: Glessner's courtyard: the plan and the section reconciled along the court
items: The 1963 survey's plan and section disagreed by up to a foot about where the hall bow, the stair tower and the terrace's end post stand. The plan's printed courtyard dimensions now settle it.
The section draws the whole court about 8 inches north of those dimensions. Corrected for that, its terrace post lands where the model already has it.
The bow and the stair tower stay where they stand. The section's stair tower was drawn about a foot too wide, and the model no longer takes its size from that drawing.
Nothing moves in the walk yet. Moving the terrace's coping and grilles to match is the next piece of work.
